newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH BICS100 BOND INDEX RISES 0.088PTS TO 102.748.
newsitem.headline: CZECH BICS100 BOND INDEX RISES 0.088PTS TO 102.748.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds rose 0.088 points in Wednesday's trading to 102.748, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.048 points to 2.480 years.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, rose 0.075 points to 99.388, the bank said, and the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.003 points to 2.454 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 fell 2.705 points to 1,054.458.
